package releasetransition

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"github.com/Subyard/Subyard/internal/testkit"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"
)

func TestExportCompletedInstallation(t *testing.T) {
	version := os.Getenv("FIXTURE_VERSION")
	for _, checkpoint := range []bool{false, true} {
		name := "plain"
		if checkpoint {
			name = "checkpointed"
		}
		t.Run(name, func(t *testing.T) {
			release := ReleaseID(version + "-aaaaaaaaaaaa")
			payload, err := os.ReadFile("../../config/release-transition.json")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			options := V2Options{ConfigHome: testkit.TempDir(t), RegistryPayload: payload, ArtifactDigest: digestA,
				Releases: ReleasePair{From: release, Target: release}, ObserveLinks: func(context.Context) (ReleaseLinks, error) { return ReleaseLinks{Active: release}, nil },
				OwnerRegistration: &v2TestOwnerRegistration{state: OwnerRegistrationAbsent}, RegisteredYards: []V2ActivationReconciler{}, GuestDiskTmp: []V2ActivationReconciler{},
				MigrationCheckpoint: checkpoint, SourceMigrationCheckpoint: true, NewTransactionID: func() TransactionID { return "tx-completed-install" }, VerifyAuthorization: func(p PlanToken, a Authorization) bool { return a == v2TestAuthorization(p) },
			}
			engine, err := NewV2Transition(options)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			goal := Goal{Target: release, Direction: DirectionActivateTarget}
			plan, err := engine.Inspect(context.Background(), goal)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			out, err := engine.Converge(context.Background(), Execution{Plan: plan.Plan, Authorization: v2TestAuthorization(plan.Plan)})
			if err != nil || out.Status != StatusReady || len(out.Warnings) != 0 {
				t.Fatalf("tag install: %#v %v", out, err)
			}
			snapshot, err := engine.store.ReadCurrentJournal()
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			journal, err := ParseJournal(snapshot.Payload)
			if err != nil || journal.Checkpoint != JournalComplete || len(journal.Steps) != 6 {
				t.Fatalf("journal: %#v %v", journal, err)
			}
			for _, step := range journal.Steps {
				if step.Checkpoint != StepVerified {
					t.Fatal("unfinished migration")
				}
			}
			state, err := engine.store.ReadMigrationLedger(engine.registry, engine.registryDigest)
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if state.Checkpointed != checkpoint {
				t.Fatal("wrong checkpoint shape")
			}
			files := map[string]string{}
			err = filepath.Walk(options.ConfigHome, func(path string, info os.FileInfo, err error) error {
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if info.IsDir() {
					return nil
				}
				body, err := os.ReadFile(path)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				rel, err := filepath.Rel(options.ConfigHome, path)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				files[filepath.ToSlash(rel)] = string(body)
				return nil
			})
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			bytes, err := json.MarshalIndent(files, "", "  ")
			if err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			destination := filepath.Join(os.Getenv("FIXTURE_OUTPUT"), "v"+version+"-completed-install-"+name+".json")
			testkit.WriteFile(t, destination, append(bytes, '\n'), 0600)
		})
	}
}
